cross_strategy_agreement.note: Objects A and B use different n_secrets/max_cardinality values (see config below); each object's own numbers are compared, per-object, against its own isolated single-object baseline computed with no second object present at all. Agreement here means marginal MI/vulnerability per object are invariant to interleaving strategy and to the second object's presence, not that the two objects' numbers match each other.

motivation: Empirically test per-object accounting under two public interleavings. The uneven B partition makes the greedy schedule branch on a prior public B outcome; this does not test correlated-secret or joint-cap composition.
